title: Donella Meadows — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Donella Meadows's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.

pieces.title: The bathtub
pieces.caption: One tub filled two ways, with a four-second lag between hand and water. Small turns settle on the line. Yanking the taps swings past it, over the rim, and back to empty. *What is real and what is a choice:* A small simulation written for this figure, not a measurement.

challenge.by: challenger · light round, batch D (drawn diagrams) · read-only dispatch

verdicts.why: The simulation does what the caption says and tests the page's sentence instead of illustrating it, but the drawing has faults. The water stands above the rim: the level is capped at 1.2 with the rim at 1.0, so the red line runs flat-topped over the rim for seconds at a time, which a tub cannot do; cap it at the rim and mark the spill.
